text.p: Swiss sports car maker Dr. Ing. h.c. Porsche AG has signed a five-year contract with Alusuisse that calls for annual deliveries of around 150 tonnes of sheet aluminium to be used in car exteriors and interiors.
The aluminium will be used in the hardtops for Porsche's Boxster model, Alusuisse Automotive said.
Porsche signed the deal with Alusuisse Schweizerische Aluminium AG in Sierre.
Alusuisse already delivers spoilers for Porsche's 911 model.

An Alusuisse spokesman declined to give a value for the order, but noted the annual use of aluminium in European car production -- where Alusuisse has a market share of over 50 percent -- was 50,000 to 60,000 tonnes.
